answer: Sybil resistance leverages a trust-graph where each AI agent is a `vertex`. Identity proof is established via verifiable computation and attestation from existing trusted agents. A strong trust `ridge` forms between interconnected, high-reputation `vertex`es. To cultivate an `orchard` of fake identities, an attacker faces a prohibitively high cumulative cost: the initial computational proof-of-work or stake for each `vertex`, combined with the steep transactional and time investment needed to bootstrap credible trust `ridge`s across their fabricated network.
